description: Medicare and Medicaid drug spending — Government spending on one drug: drug= brand or generic name (e.g. Eliquis, apixaban, Keytruda), program=partd (default) | partb | medicaid. Returns every matching product with total spending, claims, beneficiaries, dosage units, average spend per unit, per claim and per beneficiary for each year (latest 5 years), 1-year and multi-year growth, CMS unit-cost change and CAGR, Part B average sales price, and the manufacturer split. Gross spending before rebates. Source: CMS Medicare Part D / Part B and Medicaid Spending by Drug datasets on data.cms.gov (US government, public domain). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_drug_spending
